title: Hyaluronic Acid for Scalp and Hair: What the Research Shows
seo_title: Hyaluronic Acid for Scalp & Hair: What Studies Show | FullyVital
seo_description: No trial tests hyaluronic acid on a dry scalp. See what an injection study, a mouse study and a filler case report found.
notes: Citation style v2: 3 studies, each cited once, all in the second half; Key Takeaways and FAQ carry no links.
Merge target; old title 'A Moisture Miracle For Dry Scalps' dropped; unsourced.
flags: Medical procedures (injections, fillers) mentioned neutrally with doctor referral; nothing recommends them.
Siquier-Dameto: no control group stated by me from the abstract (it describes none); product has other ingredients.
Kim 2022 involves minoxidil in mice only; mentioned as part of the finding.
